name: Spyglass of True Seeing
body:
Aura faint transmutation; CL 12th; Slot none; Price 90,000 gp; Weight —

DESCRIPTION

This uncanny magical item appears to be a spyglass of magnificent craftsmanship. It operates as a normal spyglass providing the wearer a +5 bonus to Perception checks and doubling their normal viewing range. Once per day the glass can be called upon to reveal those things which can only be seen through the power of magic (as a true seeing spell, CL 12th).

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Feats Craft Wondrous Item; Spells true seeing; Cost 45,000 gp.
